explicit_requirements: Build a fully functioning DCF model in Excel for Exxon Mobil Corporation (XOM) with IPO pricing application

Incorporate the latest quarterly financial data from XOM's 2026-03-31 filing (revenues of $85.138B, net income of $4.183B, total assets of $464.41B, liabilities of $203.414B, stockholders' equity of $254.381B, cash of $8.435B, diluted EPS of $1.00)
Include a comparable company analysis / trading multiples tab using relevant energy sector peers
Build explicit revenue build-up and margin assumption schedules with clearly labeled user-adjustable inputs
Model a full projection period (minimum 5 years forward) with terminal value calculation using both perpetuity growth and exit multiple methods
Calculate enterprise value, equity value, and implied share price with bridge reconciliation
Deliver the completed model by end of day Friday May 16, 2026
Include a dedicated assumptions / outputs dashboard tab summarizing key valuation ranges
implicit_requirements: Model conventions: projection years across columns, line items down rows; blue font for hard-coded inputs, black for formulas per industry standard
Working capital schedule must separate operating current assets and liabilities with cash and debt treated outside operating working capital
Capex and depreciation must be modeled explicitly with a PP&E roll-forward schedule
WACC calculation must pull current XOM market cap, use CAPM for cost of equity with appropriate energy sector beta and risk-free rate sourced from observable market data
Terminal value must be sanity-checked against implied exit multiples and peer ranges
Free cash flow to firm (FCFF) must reconcile properly from EBIT through NOPAT, D&A, capex, and changes in working capital
All monetary values should be presented in millions (USD) with consistent decimal formatting
The model must be audit-friendly: no circular references without iteration switches, all assumptions traceable to source

input_attachments.description: Five-year historical financial summary for Exxon Mobil Corporation (XOM)

reference_answer.narrative_prompt:
You are an associate analyst at an investment bank. You have built a 5-year unlevered DCF model for Exxon Mobil Corporation (XOM) based on its latest SEC filings.

The model includes:
- Base-year financials from EDGAR XBRL
- Revenue growth assumption of 4.0% (sector-typical for energy)
- WACC of 6.98% derived from beta=1.00, Rf=4.35%, ERP=5.50%
- Terminal growth of 2.00%

Write a one-page summary memo explaining the key assumptions and valuation conclusion. Be specific with numbers. Do NOT use AI hedging.
